project: Naruto: Rise of a Ninja — Recomp
approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 PowerPC code into C++ with the ReXGlue SDK, whose runtime provides system services, graphics, audio and input.
notes: Native Windows x64 port (Direct3D 12). Features 21:9 and 32:9 ultrawide, 1x-4x resolution scaling, FXAA, an FPS/frametime overlay, character DLC support through an additional recompiled engine module, and a launcher and installer in seven languages. Players supply their own Xbox 360 game files.
